findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_plan, get_plan, add_place, open_planner · Private data: create_plan, join_plan, set_availability, set_rsvp, add_place, vote_place, add_checklist_item, check_item, update_event, add_expense, record_payment, remove_entry, widget_write, open_planner · Public sink: create_plan, get_plan · Destructive: set_availability, set_rsvp, vote_place, remove_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_plan, get_plan, add_place, open_planner · Private data: create_plan, join_plan, set_availability, set_rsvp, add_place, vote_place, add_checklist_item, check_item, update_event, add_expense, record_payment, remove_entry, widget_write, open_planner · Public sink: create_plan, get_plan · Destructive: set_availability, set_rsvp, vote_place, remove_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
